resources.content:
# Wired — Vetta Edition

A complete worked example of this system ships alongside this spec as `demo.html`: every rule below applied to one real page, including its mobile layout and a set of deliberately off-style counter-examples. It is the reference for what "on-style" looks like here.

## Atmosphere
A printed technology magazine that refuses to dress as a SaaS site. White paper,
one black wordmark, enormous high-contrast serif headlines and story rows split
by hairlines. There is no decorative chrome, no gradient, no accent block — the
type is the entire show, and black-on-white is the brand's only "color scheme".

## Color roles
All colors come from `theme.css` tokens — never hardcode hex in frames.
- `surface` is the white page; `surface-raised` (#f5f5f5) is a rare tint for
  comment areas and quiet bands.
- `primary` is pure black — wordmark, every CTA fill, the heavy 2px campaign
  border, and the footer surface. It is never softened toward gray.
- `muted` (#757575) carries bylines, timestamps and supporting metadata.
- `accent` (#057dbc) exists for exactly one job: inline links inside long-form
  body copy. It never touches navigation, buttons or headlines.
- `border` (#e0e0e0) is the 1px hairline — the brand's only line and its only
  elevation cue.

## Typography
Three faces, three roles — the pairing is the identity:
- Display serif (high-contrast, tall and narrow): 64/48/32px at weight 400.
  Elegance comes from the typeface design; never promote the weight.
- Serif body (humanist): 16–19px at ~1.45 line-height for long-form reading,
  plus serif 700 bylines with generous 2.2 line-height.
- Sans (humanist grotesque): nav, category eyebrows, buttons and metadata at
  14–17px, weights 400/700. Serifs never set UI; sans never sets prose.

## Shape & depth
- Every interactive shape is square: 0px on buttons, inputs and cards. The only
  circles are small icon containers and avatars.
- No drop shadows anywhere. Flat white on white, separated by hairlines; the
  loudest move available is a 2px solid black border.

## Components
- Masthead: thin top band with the black wordmark centered, section nav flanking,
  Subscribe at the right.
- Category eyebrow: 14px sans 700 uppercase above every headline.
- Cover story: 64px serif display over a full-bleed 16:9 duotone image, with a
  serif-bold byline row beneath.
- Story card: photo on top (4:3), 20px sans-bold headline, gray sans lead.
- Story row: bold sans headline with gray meta, divided by 1px hairlines; the
  rows stay single-column at every width.
- Buttons: black filled square and black-outlined square, 16px/700 labels;
  circular outline buttons only for share icons.
- Inputs: white field with a 1px black border, square.
- Footer: near-black band — wordmark plus dense sans link columns and fine print.

## Layout
A wide editorial container (~1400px) with a magazine grid: one cover story,
two-up secondary cards, then the hairline-divided story stack at 16px vertical
padding. Section padding runs 48px top and bottom. Whitespace is set by the
hairline grid, not by card boxes.

## Don'ts
- Don't introduce a second chromatic accent; the link blue belongs inside
  article prose and nowhere else.
- Don't round any button, input or card corner — square is non-negotiable.
- Don't hang shadows on cards; hairlines and surface contrast do all elevation.
- Don't set display in a sans face or push display weight past 400.
- Don't set prose in the sans, or nav and buttons in a serif.
- Don't replace the story-row hairlines with boxed cards.

Black, white, and one blue that stays in the prose

Black is the brand: the wordmark, the CTA fill, the campaign border, the footer band. The link blue exists to mark destinations inside an article and never graduates to navigation or buttons. Everything else is paper and hairlines.

What breaks the magazine

Same content, on-style White paper · hairline above and below · square black CTA · uppercase sans eyebrow. The hairline grid is the whole structure.

Also out: display set in a sans or pushed past weight 400, shadows on cards, and the link blue anywhere outside article prose.

resources.content:
# Zapier — Vetta Edition

A complete worked example of this system ships alongside this spec as `demo.html`: every rule below applied to one real page, including its mobile layout and a set of deliberately off-style counter-examples. It is the reference for what "on-style" looks like here.

## Atmosphere
Automation that feels approachable. Warm cream instead of cool white, coffee
ink instead of black, and a single confident orange that carries every
conversion. The middle-radius, middle-weight voice says friendly competence —
a tool that connects apps without intimidating the person wiring them.

## Color roles
All colors come from `theme.css` tokens — never hardcode hex in frames.
- `surface` is warm cream (#fffefb), never pure white; `surface-raised`
  (#f8f4f0) deepens it for cards and inset wells. Temperature is identity.
- `primary` (#ff4f00) is the one saturated orange: primary CTAs and the
  zap-live toggle, with warm-white `primary-foreground` text.
- `accent` is not a second hue — it is the coffee ink (#201515) itself, doing
  double duty as the fill of secondary buttons, featured cards and dark bands.
  There is deliberately no purple, blue or yellow accent in this system.
- Text: `surface-foreground` coffee ink; secondary `muted` (#605d52).
- `danger` (#d0342c) marks failed runs and destructive actions only.

## Typography
System sans, two registers:
- Display 32–56px at weight 500 with calm leading; card titles 20–24px at 600.
- Body 16–18px at 400; buttons 16–18px at 600.
- Uppercase eyebrows at 14px with +1px tracking introduce sections — the only
  sanctioned uppercase.
- Sentence case everywhere, even hero headlines.

## Shape & depth
- 12px is the canonical radius for buttons and cards (`radius-md`); inputs and
  chips take 6px; badges are the only full pills. Nothing goes fully square or
  fully round except badges.
- Elevation is surface contrast first: cream cards on cream page, or ink
  borders on the important containers. Full-strength ink 1px borders mark
  editable, structural things — pricing cards, editor steps, inputs.
- `shadow-md`/`shadow-lg` are warm-tinted and rare: floating menus and modals
  only.

## Components
- Buttons: 44–48px at `radius-md` — orange fill, ink fill, or cream with an ink
  outline. The label sits at 600.
- Zap step cards: white with a 1px ink border and 12px radius; app icon tile,
  event line, account line; connected by vertical dashed ink lines with a
  circular + affordance between steps.
- Status toggle: 44px pill switch; orange when the zap is live, gray when off.
- Template cards: `surface-raised` cream, no border, an icon pair joined by a
  short connector, title at 600, meta line in `muted`.
- Run log rows: mono timestamps, status dot, step count — quiet and scannable.

## Layout
Content centers near 1280px with generous gutters. The editor is a two-column
canvas (steps + history); marketing bands breathe at 64px, cards pad at 24px.
Grids run 3–4-up → 2-up → 1-up at 16–24px gutters.

## Don'ts
- Never swap the cream canvas for pure white or the coffee ink for pure black —
  warmth is the brand's temperature signal.
- Don't render buttons as pills or as sharp rectangles; 12px is the signature.
- Don't add a second chromatic accent — orange, cream and coffee are the whole
  palette; app icons are the only place other colors appear.
- Don't spend orange on decoration, links or backgrounds; it converts or it
  signals "live", nothing else.
- No cool-gray neutrals anywhere; every gray carries coffee warmth.

01 — Color

One orange, everything else coffee

Orange carries exactly two jobs: the primary CTA and the live toggle. Secondary actions fall to ink-filled or outlined buttons; there is no second accent hue in the system. App icons — sheets, chats, bases — are the only multicolor moments, and they always sit inside neutral cards.

Failed runs take a warm red, never orange-red confusion: danger is #d0342c and lives in status contexts only.

02 — Shape

The confident middle radius

Buttons and cards land at 12px — friendlier than a square, more grounded than a pill. Inputs and chips step down to 6px, badges stay fully round, and the important containers draw a full-strength ink border: an editor step card is something you are about to edit, and it looks the part.

Connectors between steps are dashed ink lines with a circular add button — the line itself explains the product: steps flow down, linked by you.

03 — Mobile

The editor folds into a story

On a phone the zap becomes a vertical story: trigger, connector, actions, with the history panel tucked behind the header. The publish button and live toggle stay pinned where thumbs land.

  • ConnectorsThe dashed line and add button survive at two-thirds scale; they are the product's mental model and are never dropped.

  • ActionsPublish keeps its 12px radius and orange fill at full width; Test sits beside it as an outline — never two orange buttons.
  • HistoryThe run panel becomes a route; rows keep dots, mono timestamps and step counts.
  • TemplatesThe 4-up grid falls to 2-up, then 1-up; cream wells need no border to separate at any width.
  • TouchRows and connectors extend to 44px tap targets; the add button is the largest hit area on the canvas.

04 — Off-style, for contrast

What reads as “not zapier”

Pill button, second accent Pure-white card · fully rounded button · a purple CTA competing with orange · cool gray shadow. The temperature, the middle radius and the single-accent rule all break at once.
Same content, on-style Cream well at 12px radius, ink or orange actions, warm shadow. One saturated color does the converting; the neutrals stay warm and quiet.

Also out: pure-white pages, pure-black ink, square-cornered CTAs, orange used as decoration or link color, and cool-gray neutrals anywhere.

# MongoDB — Vetta Edition

A complete worked example of this system ships alongside this spec as `demo.html`: every rule below applied to one real page, including its mobile layout and a set of deliberately off-style counter-examples. It is the reference for what "on-style" looks like here.

## Atmosphere
Enterprise calm with a leaf-green pulse. Stark white surfaces carry dense
database work in near-teal ink; the bright green pill is the single moment of
conviction on every screen. Pragmatic, data-forward, never playful.

## Color roles
All colors come from `theme.css` tokens — never hardcode hex in frames.
- `surface` is plain white — page and cards share it; structure comes from 1px
  `border`, and `surface-raised` (#f4f7f6) marks wells and inset sections.
- `primary` (#00ed64) is the bright leaf green and belongs to pill buttons and
  small highlight badges — with dark teal `primary-foreground` text on it,
  never white.
- `accent` (#00684a) is the deep green for inline links, active underline tabs
  and focus borders; it reads as "same conviction, indoor voice".
- Text: `surface-foreground` (#001e2b) ink; secondary text `muted` (#5c6c7a).
- `danger` (#cf4a35) covers destructive actions and failing states only.

## Typography
System sans with a geometric, even-tempered voice:
- Display 40–56px at weight 500 with tight (-0.5 to -1.5px) tracking and 1.1
  leading; section heads 22–28px.
- Body 14–16px at 400 with 1.5 leading; labels and buttons 14px at 600.
- Uppercase micro tags at 11–12px with +1px tracking encode categories.
- Monospace for collection names, connection strings and metrics values.

## Shape & depth
- Cards sit at `radius-lg` (12px); inputs and code blocks at `radius-md` (8px);
  every button and status badge is a full pill — the pill is a signature, never
  square it.
- Elevation is quiet and teal-tinted: flat hairline cards by default,
  `shadow-md` on hover-elevated tiles, `shadow-lg` for floating code mockups.
- The one inverted surface is the near-teal code block (`surface-foreground`
  used as a dark fill) with white text.

## Components
- Buttons: pill, 40–44px, 600 labels. Primary green fill; secondary is an
  outlined pill with 1px strong border; tertiary ghost.
- Cards: white, 1px `border`, `radius-lg`, 20–32px padding; feature wells use
  `surface-raised` with no border.
- Tables: `radius-md` frame, hairline rows, 14px cells; numbers right-aligned
  and tabular.
- Badges: two shapes — soft mint pill for status, tiny `radius-sm` tags for
  categories (a narrow set of saturated tag colors, nothing else).
- Underline tabs: inactive `muted`, active `accent` with a 2px bottom rule.
- Inputs: 44px, 1px `border`, 8px radius; focus swaps to a 2px `accent` border.

## Layout
1280px max with 32px gutters. Marketing bands breathe at 64–96px; product
screens tighten to 24–32px. Card grids run 3-up → 2-up → 1-up. White space is
generous between sections, frugal inside tables.

## Don'ts
- The bright green is never body text, a background wash or a border — it is
  pills and badges, full strength or nothing.
- Don't square the pill buttons; don't round the category tags into pills.
- No shadows on plain documentation tables; elevation is reserved for mockups.
- Don't add saturated color beyond green and the small category-tag set.
- Monospace never carries prose.

01 — Color

Green at full strength or not at all

The bright leaf green belongs to pill buttons and highlight badges, always solid with dark teal text on it. Deep green handles links, active tabs and data marks. The only other saturated colors are the tiny category tags — a fixed, narrow set.

primary#00ed64 · pills, badges
accent#00684a · links, marks
raised#f4f7f6 · wells, headers
ink#001e2b · text, code block
CORE SEARCH Healthy

Category tags stay square-cornered and small — they encode a fixed vocabulary and are the only place purple or orange may appear. Never reuse them as button or link colors.

02 — Structure

Pills for people, rectangles for data

Every interactive button is a full pill at 42px — squaring it breaks the brand signature. Content containers are 12px rounded rectangles, tables sit in 8px frames, and the code block is the one inverted island on the page, floating on a teal-tinted shadow.

Overview Collections Indexes mongosh …

Inputs focus to a 2px deep-green border; rows stay hairline gray. Elevation scales are teal-tinted, not gray, so shadows never turn muddy on white.

03 — Mobile

The console in one thumb column

Cluster cards stack first, the collections table keeps its three most-read columns, and the connect block collapses to a single copyable string. The green pill survives as a full thumb-width action above the tab bar.

  • TableFive columns drop to two — collection name and document count. Category tags and sizes live on the detail page.
  • Metric chartsBars thin out and lose hourly labels; a single axis caption carries the time range.
  • Connection blockThe multi-line snippet becomes a one-line string with a copy affordance; monospace sizing never drops below 12px.
  • ActionsThe green pill keeps its 42px height at full width — a shrunken pill reads as disabled.
  • NavTop tabs become a four-item bottom bar; the active item keeps its deep-green color but loses the underline rule.
  • SearchThe 44px search pill moves under the header and keeps its inset-well background.

04 — Off-style, for contrast

Where enterprise calm breaks

Green wash in a pill box Bright green at 15% as a card fill, text set in deep green, everything rounded to a pill. The signal color becomes wallpaper and the hierarchy disappears.
Same content, on-style White card with a hairline border, ink text, and green reserved for the pill button and status badge. Data marks use deep green; the background never gets tinted.

Also out: squared pill buttons, rounded-off category tags, gray shadows on plain tables, and monospace prose — each one erodes the pragmatic enterprise voice.

resources.content:
# Framer — Vetta Edition

The companion `demo.html` stages one real screen — a visual site-builder session on a
near-black canvas, with a layer tree, a selected button mid-edit and its inspector —
from the rules below, then adds the phone breakpoint and deliberate off-style
counter-examples. Treat it as the reference for what on-style means here.

## Atmosphere
The page is a working artboard. Everything sits on a near-black canvas, the chrome
stays monochrome and quiet, and the type does the talking: white display sizes with
poster-tight tracking. Color is rationed — one blue signal for selection, focus and
links, violet held back for the gradient spotlights that showcase work. Dark is the single mode the brand ships; it never turns light.

## Color roles
All colors come from `theme.css` tokens — never hardcode hex in frames.
- `surface` (#090909) is the canvas itself; `surface-raised` (#141414) lifts cards,
  panels and inputs one step, and a further lift is white at roughly 4% alpha laid
  over raised.
- `primary` is Framer Blue (#0099ff) and it is a signal, never a surface: selection
  frames and handles, focus rings, hyperlinks. It never fills a button or a panel.
- The signature CTA inverts the canvas: a white pill (surface-foreground as its fill)
  carrying the canvas color as its ink. `primary-foreground` is the ink that sits on
  blue.
- `accent` (#6a4cf5) leads the gradient family — magenta #d44df0, violet #6a4cf5,
  orange #ff7a3d, coral #ff5577. Gradients live only on spotlight tiles as inline
  values; they are decoration anchors, not chrome.
- Text is `surface-foreground`; secondary text is `muted` (#999999). Nothing lives
  between ink and muted — there is no mid-gray scale.
- `danger` (#ff5577) borrows the coral anchor, since the palette ships no dedicated
  error tone. Hairline `border` (#262626) does all separation; dim it for soft
  dividers inside cards.

## Typography
Two families, hierarchy carried by size and tracking — not weight:
- Display: GT Walsheim Medium (fallback: a geometric grotesk at 500–600). Tiers run
  110 / 85 / 62 / 32px with a fixed −5% tracking. When space runs out, step the size
  down — the tracking percentage itself never shrinks.
- Body: Inter at 15px / 1.3, with its OpenType character variants (cv01, cv05, cv09,
  cv11, ss03, ss07) and tabular numerals wherever data lines up.
- Builder chrome: 11–12px labels in `muted`; coordinates, sizes and values in mono.

## Shape & depth
- Radius scale 4 / 10 / 15 / 20 / 30: controls at 10, template cards at 15–20,
  gradient spotlight tiles at 30, CTAs always full pills.
- Depth is a surface lift, not a shadow stack: canvas → raised → white-alpha.
  `shadow-sm` is a barely-there drop; `shadow-md` adds a top light edge for floating
  cards; `shadow-lg` is for modals and popovers above everything.
- Selection is a ring, not a fill: a 1px ring of `primary` at 15% marks selected
  elements, with solid handles drawn on the canvas around the active one.

## Components
- Primary CTA: white pill, roughly 10px 15px padding; pressed feedback is a slight
  scale-down, never a darker fill. Secondary: charcoal pill. Over imagery:
  translucent pill with a blur.
- Icon buttons are 40px circles; the top nav is a 56px bar; the footer is a
  caption-grid of small links.
- Tabs and pricing toggles show selection with a surface lift — raised fill and a
  hairline edge — never with color.
- Inputs sit on `surface-raised` and take a blue-tinted focus ring in `primary`.
- Gradient spotlight tiles: one or two per viewport, doing the atmospheric work that
  gradients otherwise smear across whole sections.

## Layout
A 5px base unit: 5 / 10 / 15 / 20 / 30 / 40, with sections at 96px. Content tops out
around 1200px wide; the dark canvas itself is the whitespace. Sections separate by
surface mode — black band, raised card band, gradient tile — instead of divider
lines. At the 1199px and 810px breakpoints grids collapse, the nav folds into a
menu, comparison tables become per-tier accordions, and display type steps down
while keeping its tracking ratio.

## Don'ts
- No light mode, ever, and no mid-tone grays beyond `muted`.
- Blue never fills: no blue buttons, no blue panels — selection, focus and links
  only.
- CTAs never get squared corners; the pill is part of the voice.
- Gradients belong on tiles, not on section backgrounds.
- No second chromatic accent — violet is the only other hue, and only inside tiles.
- No poster scale inside tool chrome: builder panels stay at 11–13px.

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Framer — component reference</title>
<style>
	/* Mirrors theme.css. Plain custom properties so this file opens standalone. */
	:root {
		--color-primary: #0099ff;
		--color-primary-foreground: #ffffff;
		--color-surface: #090909;
		--color-surface-foreground: #ffffff;
		--color-surface-raised: #141414;
		--color-muted: #999999;
		--color-accent: #6a4cf5;
		--color-danger: #ff5577;
		--color-border: #262626;

		--radius-sm: 4px;
		--radius-md: 10px;
		--radius-lg: 15px;
		--radius-xl: 20px;
		--radius-2xl: 30px;

		--shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.4);
		--shadow-md: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.06), 0 10px 30px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.25);
		--shadow-lg: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.06), 0 24px 64px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.5);

		--sans: "Inter", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
		--display: "GT Walsheim", "Inter", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
		--mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
	}

	*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
	body {
		margin: 0;
		background: var(--color-surface);
		color: var(--color-surface-foreground);
		font-family: var(--sans);
		font-size: 14px;
		line-height: 1.5;
		-webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
	}
	h1, h2, h3 { margin: 0; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.03em; line-height: 1.2; }
	p { margin: 0; }
	::selection { background: rgb(0 153 255 / 0.35); }
	.spacer { flex: 1; }

	/* ── Builder shell: monochrome chrome split by hairlines ──────── */
	.shell { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border); }
	.top {
		display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px;
		height: 44px; padding: 0 14px;
		border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border);
	}
	.mark { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }
	.mark i { width: 11px; height: 3px; background: var(--color-surface-foreground); border-radius: 1px; display: block; }
	.mark i:nth-child(2) { width: 7px; }
	.mark i:nth-child(3) { width: 11px; }
	.brand { font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
	.proj { font-size: 12px; color: var(--color-muted); }
	.divider { width: 1px; height: 18px; background: var(--color-border); }
	.chip {
		display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
		height: 26px; padding: 0 10px;
		border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 9999px;
		font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--color-muted);
	}
	.bp { display: flex; gap: 2px; padding: 2px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 9999px; }
	.bp span {
		height: 22px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 9999px;
		display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
		font-size: 11px; color: var(--color-muted);
	}
	.bp span b { font-family: var(--mono); font-weight: 400; font-size: 10px; }
	.bp .is-active { background: var(--color-surface-raised); border: 1px solid var(--color-border); color: var(--color-surface-foreground); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); }
	.avatar { width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); display: block; }
	.avatar + .avatar { margin-left: -6px; }
	.publish {
		height: 26px; padding: 0 13px; border-radius: 9999px;
		background: var(--color-surface-foreground); color: var(--color-surface);
		font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 500;
		display: inline-flex; align-items: center;
	}

	.body { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
	@media (min-width: 1020px) { .body { grid-template-columns: 208px minmax(0, 1fr) 268px; } }

	/* ── Layer tree ───────────────────────────────────────────────── */
	.layers { display: none; border-right: 1px solid var(--color-border); padding: 10px 8px; }
	@media (min-width: 1020px) { .layers { display: block; } }
	.pane-label {
		font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.12em;
		text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-muted); padding: 2px 8px 8px;
		display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
	}
	.pane-label .add { margin-left: auto; color: var(--color-muted); font-size: 12px; }
	.lrow {
		display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px;
		height: 26px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
		font-size: 12px; color: var(--color-muted);
	}
	.lrow .tw { width: 10px; text-align: center; font-size: 8px; opacity: 0.7; }
	.lrow .ic { width: 12px; text-align: center; font-size: 10px; opacity: 0.75; font-family: var(--mono); }
	.lrow .eye { margin-left: auto; font-size: 9px; opacity: 0.5; }
	.lrow.lv2 { padding-left: 24px; }
	.lrow.lv3 { padding-left: 40px; }
	.lrow.is-active {
		background: rgb(0 153 255 / 0.18);
		color: var(--color-surface-foreground);
		box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 var(--color-primary);
	}

	/* ── Canvas: dot grid, artboard, selection hardware ───────────── */
	.canvas {
		min-width: 0; padding: 34px 24px 44px;
		background-image: radial-gradient(rgb(255 255 255 / 0.05) 1px, transparent 1px);
		background-size: 22px 22px;
		overflow: hidden;
	}
	.frame-tag {
		width: 660px; max-width: 100%; margin: 0 auto 8px;
		font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 10px; color: var(--color-muted);
		display: flex; gap: 10px;
	}
	.frame-tag .sel { color: var(--color-primary); }
	.artboard {
		width: 660px; max-width: 100%; margin: 0 auto;
		background: var(--color-surface);
		border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
		border-radius: 2px;
		box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
		padding: 30px 34px 34px;
	}
	.ab-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; }
	.ab-nav .ab-brand { font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
	.ab-nav .ab-links { display: flex; gap: 14px; font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--color-muted); }
	.ab-pill-s { height: 24px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-surface-foreground); color: var(--color-surface); font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 500; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; }

	.ab-hero { margin-top: 42px; }
	.ab-kicker { font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-muted); }
	.ab-h1 {
		margin-top: 12px;
		font-family: var(--display); font-weight: 500;
		font-size: 38px; letter-spacing: -0.045em; line-height: 1.04;
	}
	.ab-sub { margin-top: 12px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--color-muted); max-width: 46ch; }
	.ab-cta { margin-top: 24px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
	.ab-pill {
		height: 40px; padding: 0 18px; border-radius: 9999px;
		display: inline-flex; align-items: center;
		font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500;
	}
	.ab-pill-white { background: var(--color-surface-foreground); color: var(--color-surface); }
	.ab-pill-char { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.08); color: var(--color-surface-foreground); border: 1px solid var(--color-border); }

	/* selection hardware: blue outline, handles, live size tag */
	.fr-sel { position: relative; outline: 1.5px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset: 2px; }
	.fr-sel .hd { position: absolute; width: 7px; height: 7px; background: #fff; border: 1.5px solid var(--color-primary); border-radius: 1px; }
	.hd-tl { top: -6px; left: -6px; }
	.hd-tr { top: -6px; right: -6px; }
	.hd-bl { bottom: -6px; left: -6px; }
	.hd-br { bottom: -6px; right: -6px; }
	.fr-size {
		position: absolute; top: -23px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
		background: var(--color-primary); color: var(--color-primary-foreground);
		font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 9px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.03em;
		padding: 3px 6px; border-radius: 3px; white-space: nowrap;
	}

	/* gap measurement between CTA row and the card row */
	.fr-gap { position: relative; height: 26px; margin-left: 2px; }
	.fr-gap::before {
		content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 2px; bottom: 2px; width: 5px;
		border-left: 1px solid var(--color-primary);
		border-top: 1px solid var(--color-primary);
		border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-primary);
		opacity: 0.8;
	}
	.fr-gap span {
		position: absolute; left: 10px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%);
		font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 9px; color: var(--color-primary);
	}

	.ab-cards { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px; }
	.ab-tile {
		border-radius: var(--radius-2xl); padding: 20px; min-height: 148px;
		background: linear-gradient(135deg, #6a4cf5, #d44df0);
		display: flex; flex-direction: column;
	}
	.ab-tile .t-chip {
		align-self: flex-start; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.1em;
		text-transform: uppercase; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 9999px;
		background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.16); color: #fff;
	}
	.ab-tile h3 { margin-top: auto; font-family: var(--display); font-weight: 500; font-size: 17px; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: #fff; }
	.ab-tile p { margin-top: 4px; font-size: 11px; color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.75); }
	.ab-card {
		border-radius: var(--radius-xl); padding: 20px; min-height: 148px;
		background: var(--color-surface-raised); border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
		box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
		display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px;
	}
	.ab-card i { display: block; height: 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.07); }
	.ab-card i:nth-child(1) { width: 62%; }
	.ab-card i:nth-child(2) { width: 84%; }
	.ab-card i:nth-child(3) { width: 48%; }
	.ab-card p { margin-top: auto; font-size: 11px; color: var(--color-muted); }
	.ab-card p b { color: var(--color-surface-foreground); font-weight: 500; }

	/* ── Inspector ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
	.insp { display: none; border-left: 1px solid var(--color-border); padding: 10px 12px; }
	@media (min-width: 1020px) { .insp { display: block; } }
	.insp-tabs { display: flex; gap: 4px; padding: 0 0 10px; }
	.insp-tabs span { font-size: 11px; color: var(--color-muted); padding: 4px 9px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); }
	.insp-tabs .is-active { background: var(--color-surface-raised); border: 1px solid var(--color-border); color: var(--color-surface-foreground); }
	.sec-label {
		font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 9.5px; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase;
		color: var(--color-muted); padding: 12px 2px 6px;
		border-top: 1px solid var(--color-border);
	}
	.sec-label:first-of-type { border-top: 0; }
	.irow { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 28px; padding: 0 2px; font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--color-muted); }
	.irow .val {
		font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--color-surface-foreground);
		border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
		background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.02);
		padding: 3px 7px; min-width: 52px; text-align: right;
	}
	.irow .val + .val { margin-left: -1px; }
	.irow .grow { flex: 1; }
	.irow .sw { width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); border: 1px solid var(--color-border); display: inline-block; }
	.irow .eye { margin-left: auto; font-size: 9px; opacity: 0.5; }

	/* ── Status bar ───────────────────────────────────────────────── */
	.statusbar {
		display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px;
		height: 24px; padding: 0 14px; border-top: 1px solid var(--color-border);
		font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 10px; color: var(--color-muted);
	}

	.wrap { max-width: 1080px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 20px 80px; }
	@media (min-width: 768px) { .wrap { padding: 0 32px 112px; } }
	.section { padding-top: 48px; }
	@media (min-width: 768px) { .section { padding-top: 72px; } }
	.section-label {
		font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.14em;
		text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-primary); margin-bottom: 10px;
	}
	.section h2 { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 600; }
	@media (min-width: 768px) { .section h2 { font-size: 26px; } }
	.lede { color: var(--color-muted); max-width: 64ch; margin-top: 8px; font-size: 13.5px; }
	.note { margin-top: 16px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--color-muted); }
	.row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; align-items: center; }

	/* ── Demo controls ────────────────────────────────────────────── */
	.btn {
		font: inherit; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500;
		height: 40px; padding: 0 18px; border: 0; cursor: pointer;
		border-radius: 9999px;
	}
	.btn-white { background: var(--color-surface-foreground); color: var(--color-surface); }
	.btn-white:hover { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.92); }
	.btn-char { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.08); color: var(--color-surface-foreground); border: 1px solid var(--color-border); }
	.btn-char:hover { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.12); }
	.btn-trans { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.06); color: var(--color-surface-foreground); border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.12); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); }
	.btn-pressed { transform: scale(0.96); }
	.btn[disabled] { cursor: not-allowed; color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.35); background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.04); border: 1px solid var(--color-border); }
	.iconbtn {
		width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
		background: transparent; color: var(--color-surface-foreground);
		display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
		font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer;
	}
	.iconbtn:hover { background: var(--color-surface-raised); }
	.input {
		font: inherit; font-size: 13px; width: 100%; max-width: 340px;
		height: 40px; padding: 0 14px;
		border-radius: 9999px;
		border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
		background: var(--color-surface-raised); color: var(--color-surface-foreground);
	}
	.input::placeholder { color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.3); }
	.input:focus { outline: none; border-color: rgb(0 153 255 / 0.6); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(0 153 255 / 0.18); }
	.seg { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; padding: 2px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 9999px; }
	.seg span { height: 30px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 9999px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-size: 12px; color: var(--color-muted); }
	.seg .is-active { background: var(--color-surface-raised); border: 1px solid var(--color-border); color: var(--color-surface-foreground); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); }

	/* ── Swatches ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
	.swatches { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 10px; margin-top: 20px; }
	@media (min-width: 720px) { .swatches { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); } }
	.sw { border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: var(--radius-md); overflow: hidden; }
	.sw .fill { height: 52px; }
	.sw .meta { padding: 8px 10px; background: var(--color-surface-raised); }
	.sw b { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; display: block; }
	.sw span { font-size: 11px; color: var(--color-muted); }
	.grads { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 10px; margin-top: 12px; }

	.gd { height: 64px; border-radius: var(--radius-xl); border: 1px solid var(--color-border); position: relative; }
	.gd b { position: absolute; left: 8px; bottom: 8px; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.9); }

	/* ── Type specimen ────────────────────────────────────────────── */
	.spec { border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: var(--radius-xl); background: var(--color-surface-raised); padding: 24px; margin-top: 20px; }
	.spec .d1 { font-family: var(--display); font-weight: 500; font-size: 46px; letter-spacing: -0.045em; line-height: 1.02; }
	@media (min-width: 720px) { .spec .d1 { font-size: 56px; } }
	.spec .d2 { margin-top: 18px; font-family: var(--display); font-weight: 500; font-size: 28px; letter-spacing: -0.045em; }
	.spec .body { margin-top: 14px; font-size: 15px; color: var(--color-surface-foreground); max-width: 58ch; }
	.spec .body .mut { color: var(--color-muted); }
	.tiers { margin-top: 18px; border-top: 1px solid var(--color-border); }
	.tiers div {
		display: flex; gap: 16px; padding: 9px 2px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border);
		font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--color-muted);
	}
	.tiers b { color: var(--color-surface-foreground); font-weight: 500; width: 130px; flex: none; }

	.panels { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 12px; margin-top: 20px; }
	@media (min-width: 768px) { .panels { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); } }
	.panel { background: var(--color-surface-raised); border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: var(--radius-xl); padding: 16px 18px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); }
	.panel h3 { font-size: 13px; }
	.panel p { margin-top: 6px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--color-muted); }
	.metric { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 22px; letter-spacing: -0.02em; }

	/* ── Mobile breakpoint preview ────────────────────────────────── */
	.mobile { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 28px; margin-top: 24px; align-items: start; }
	@media (min-width: 860px) { .mobile { grid-template-columns: 300px 1fr; gap: 40px; } }
	.phone {
		width: 300px; max-width: 100%; margin: 0 auto;
		border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
		border-radius: 28px;
		background: var(--color-surface);
		box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
		overflow: hidden;
	}
	.phone-tag { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 10px; color: var(--color-muted); text-align: center; padding: 0 0 8px; }
	.phone-status { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 8px 16px 4px; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 10px; color: var(--color-muted); }
	.phone-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 10px 16px; }
	.phone-nav b { font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; }
	.phone-nav span { font-size: 13px; color: var(--color-muted); }
	.m-hero { padding: 18px 16px 22px; }
	.m-kicker { font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-muted); }
	.m-h1 { margin-top: 10px; font-family: var(--display); font-weight: 500; font-size: 24px; letter-spacing: -0.045em; line-height: 1.06; }
	.m-sub { margin-top: 8px; font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--color-muted); }
	.m-cta { margin-top: 16px; }
	.m-cta .btn-white { width: 100%; height: 44px; justify-content: center; display: flex; align-items: center; }
	.m-link { display: block; text-align: center; margin-top: 10px; font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--color-muted); }
	.m-tile { margin: 0 16px 18px; border-radius: var(--radius-2xl); padding: 16px; min-height: 110px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #6a4cf5, #d44df0); display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
	.m-tile .t-chip { align-self: flex-start; font-size: 8.5px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.16); color: #fff; }
	.m-tile h3 { margin-top: auto; font-family: var(--display); font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: #fff; }
	.rules { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
	.rules li { padding: 10px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border); font-size: 13px; color: var(--color-muted); display: flex; gap: 12px; }
	.rules b { color: var(--color-surface-foreground); font-weight: 500; flex: none; width: 116px; font-size: 12px; font-family: var(--mono); }
	@media (max-width: 520px) { .rules li { display: block; } .rules b { width: auto; margin-bottom: 2px; } }

	/* ── Off-style comparison ─────────────────────────────────────── */
	.compare { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 12px; margin-top: 20px; }
	@media (min-width: 720px) { .compare { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); } }
	.cmp-off {
		padding: 26px; border-radius: 8px;
		background: linear-gradient(135deg, #6a4cf5, #ff5577);
		color: #fff;
	}
	.cmp-off b { display: block; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; }
	.cmp-off p { margin-top: 10px; font-size: 12px; color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.7); }
	.cmp-off .cta {
		display: inline-block; margin-top: 14px; padding: 10px 15px;
		background: var(--color-primary); color: #fff;
		font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em;
		border-radius: 2px;
	}
	.cmp-off small { display: block; font-size: 11px; opacity: 0.8; margin-top: 16px; line-height: 1.5; }
	.cmp-on {
		padding: 20px; border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
		background: var(--color-surface-raised); border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
		display: flex; gap: 16px; align-items: center;
	}
	.cmp-on .txt b { display: block; font-family: var(--display); font-size: 19px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.045em; }
	.cmp-on .txt p { margin-top: 6px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--color-muted); }
	.cmp-on .txt .cta { display: inline-flex; margin-top: 12px; height: 34px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-surface-foreground); color: var(--color-surface); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; align-items: center; }
	.cmp-on .mini { flex: none; width: 64px; height: 64px; border-radius: var(--radius-xl); background: linear-gradient(135deg, #6a4cf5, #d44df0); }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- COVER — the builder itself: layer tree, canvas with a selected pill and live
     size tag, breakpoint switcher, inspector. Blue appears only as selection
     hardware; the artboard carries the poster typography. -->
<div class="shell">
	<div class="top">
		<span class="mark"><i></i><i></i><i></i></span>
		<span class="brand">Framer</span>
		<span class="proj">Landing · Nudge</span>
		<span class="divider"></span>
		<span class="chip">+ Insert</span>
		<span class="spacer"></span>
		<span class="bp">
			<span class="is-active">Desktop <b>1200</b></span>
			<span>Tablet <b>810</b></span>
			<span>Phone <b>390</b></span>
		</span>
		<span class="chip">100%</span>
		<span class="avatar" style="background: linear-gradient(135deg, #6a4cf5, #d44df0);"></span>
		<span class="avatar" style="background: var(--color-surface-raised);"></span>
		<span class="publish">Publish</span>
	</div>
	<div class="body">
		<aside class="layers">
			<div class="pane-label">Layers<span class="add">+</span></div>
			<div class="lrow"><span class="tw">⌄</span><span class="ic">▢</span>Desktop<span class="eye">◉</span></div>
			<div class="lrow lv2"><span class="tw">⌄</span><span class="ic">≡</span>Nav</div>
			<div class="lrow lv2"><span class="tw">⌄</span><span class="ic">≡</span>Hero</div>
			<div class="lrow lv3"><span class="tw"></span><span class="ic">T</span>Headline</div>
			<div class="lrow lv3"><span class="tw"></span><span class="ic">T</span>Subcopy</div>
			<div class="lrow lv3"><span class="tw">⌄</span><span class="ic">≡</span>Actions</div>
			<div class="lrow lv3 is-active"><span class="tw"></span><span class="ic">▭</span>Start for free</div>
			<div class="lrow lv3"><span class="tw"></span><span class="ic">▭</span>Book a demo</div>
			<div class="lrow lv2"><span class="tw"></span><span class="ic">◆</span>Spotlight tile<span class="eye">◉</span></div>
			<div class="lrow lv2"><span class="tw"></span><span class="ic">▦</span>Logos</div>
		</aside>
		<main class="canvas">
			<div class="frame-tag"><span class="sel">Desktop</span><span>1200 × 720</span></div>
			<div class="artboard">
				<div class="ab-nav">
					<span class="ab-brand">Nudge</span>
					<span class="ab-links"><span>Features</span><span>Pricing</span><span>Docs</span></span>
					<span class="spacer"></span>
					<span class="ab-pill-s">Start free</span>
				</div>
				<div class="ab-hero">
					<p class="ab-kicker">Now in public beta</p>
					<h1 class="ab-h1">Ship sites at the speed of thought</h1>
					<p class="ab-sub">Design on the canvas, publish to the edge. No handoff, no rebuild — what you draw is what ships.</p>
					<div class="ab-cta">
						<span class="ab-pill ab-pill-white fr-sel">Start for free<i class="hd hd-tl"></i><i class="hd hd-tr"></i><i class="hd hd-bl"></i><i class="hd hd-br"></i><b class="fr-size">148 × 40</b></span>
						<span class="ab-pill ab-pill-char">Book a demo</span>
					</div>
					<div class="fr-gap"><span>24</span></div>
					<div class="ab-cards">
						<div class="ab-tile">
							<span class="t-chip">AI</span>
							<h3>Copy that sounds like you</h3>
							<p>Trained on your own pages.</p>
						</div>
						<div class="ab-card">
							<i></i><i></i><i></i>
							<p><b>Analytics, built in.</b> Every frame reports back.</p>
						</div>
					</div>
				</div>
			</div>
		</main>
		<aside class="insp">
			<div class="insp-tabs"><span class="is-active">Design</span><span>CMS</span><span>Code</span></div>
			<div class="sec-label">Layout</div>
			<div class="irow"><span>Type</span><span class="grow"></span><span class="val">Stack</span></div>
			<div class="irow"><span>Direction</span><span class="grow"></span><span class="val">Horizontal</span></div>

			<div class="irow"><span>◎ linked</span><span class="grow"></span><span class="val">100</span></div>
			<div class="sec-label">Text</div>
			<div class="irow"><span>Font</span><span class="grow"></span><span class="val">Inter · 13</span></div>

		</aside>
	</div>
	<div class="statusbar">
		<span>Desktop · 1200 × 720</span>
		<span>3 breakpoints</span>
		<span class="spacer"></span>
		<span>1 layer selected</span>
		<span>100%</span>
	</div>
</div>

<div class="wrap">

	<!-- 01 CANVAS & CHROME -->
	<section class="section">
		<p class="section-label">01 — Canvas & chrome</p>
		<h2>Monochrome panels, hairline edges, blue only when something is selected</h2>
		<p class="lede">The workspace is measurable: a 44px toolbar, 26px layer rows, 28px
			inspector rows and a 24px mono status bar. Panes are flat fills split by 1px
			hairlines over a dot grid — the chrome stays monochrome so the single blue
			signal always means selection.</p>
		<div class="panels">
			<div class="panel"><div class="metric">44 / 26 / 24px</div><p>Toolbar, layer row and status bar. Fixed heights, never improvised.</p></div>
			<div class="panel"><div class="metric">1px</div><p>Every pane divider, over a faint dot grid on the canvas. No inner shadows between columns.</p></div>
			<div class="panel"><div class="metric">blue = selected</div><p>Layer rows, frames and handles tint in primary at low alpha. Blue does nothing else here.</p></div>
		</div>
	</section>

	<!-- 02 COLOR ROLES -->
	<section class="section">
		<p class="section-label">02 — Color roles</p>
		<h2>Two anchors, one signal, four gradient anchors</h2>
		<p class="lede">White and near-black carry the whole page. Blue is a signal, never a
			surface — it marks selection, focus and links. The violet gradient family does the
			atmospheric work, but only from inside tiles; chrome never picks it up.</p>
		<div class="swatches">
			<div class="sw"><div class="fill" style="background: var(--color-primary)"></div><div class="meta"><b>primary</b><span>#0099ff · selection, links</span></div></div>
			<div class="sw"><div class="fill" style="background: var(--color-accent)"></div><div class="meta"><b>accent</b><span>#6a4cf5 · gradient lead</span></div></div>
			<div class="sw"><div class="fill" style="background: var(--color-surface-raised)"></div><div class="meta"><b>raised</b><span>#141414 · cards, panels</span></div></div>
			<div class="sw"><div class="fill" style="background: var(--color-danger)"></div><div class="meta"><b>danger</b><span>#ff5577 · coral anchor</span></div></div>
		</div>
		<div class="grads">
			<div class="gd" style="background: linear-gradient(135deg, #6a4cf5, #d44df0);"><b>violet → magenta</b></div>
			<div class="gd" style="background: linear-gradient(135deg, #d44df0, #ff5577);"><b>magenta → coral</b></div>
			<div class="gd" style="background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ff7a3d, #ff5577);"><b>orange → coral</b></div>
			<div class="gd" style="background: linear-gradient(135deg, #6a4cf5, #0099ff);"><b>violet → blue</b></div>
		</div>
		<p class="note">Gradient anchors (#d44df0 / #6a4cf5 / #ff7a3d / #ff5577) are inline values on tiles, not tokens — chrome is built from theme.css tokens alone.</p>
	</section>

	<!-- 03 TYPOGRAPHY -->
	<section class="section">
		<p class="section-label">03 — Poster typography</p>
		<h2>Size and tracking carry the hierarchy, not weight</h2>
		<p class="lede">Display type is a geometric grotesk at medium weight with a fixed −5%
			tracking — the confidence comes from scale, not from going bold. Body is Inter at
			15px with its character variants; data and coordinates switch to mono.</p>
		<div class="spec">
			<p class="d1">Sites at the speed of thought</p>
			<p class="d2">Publish to the edge</p>
			<p class="body">Inter carries the reading layer at 15px / 1.3. <span class="mut">Secondary lines
				drop to muted gray — there is no third tone between ink and muted.</span></p>
			<div class="tiers">
				<div><b>Display 110 / 85</b><span>hero statements · tracking −5% fixed</span></div>
				<div><b>Display 62 / 32</b><span>section heads · same tracking ratio</span></div>
				<div><b>Body 15 / 12</b><span>paragraphs, captions · OpenType cv01 cv05 cv09 cv11 ss03 ss07</span></div>
				<div><b>Mono 10–11</b><span>coordinates, sizes, tokens, status bar</span></div>
			</div>
		</div>
		<p class="note">When a headline outgrows its box, step the size down — the tracking percentage never shrinks.</p>
	</section>

	<!-- 04 CONTROLS -->
	<section class="section">
		<p class="section-label">04 — Pills, lift & selection</p>
		<h2>CTAs are pills; selection is a surface lift or a blue ring</h2>
		<div class="row" style="margin-top: 20px;">
			<button class="btn btn-white">Start for free</button>
			<button class="btn btn-char">Book a demo</button>
			<button class="btn btn-trans">Watch the film</button>
			<button class="btn btn-white btn-pressed">Pressed = scale</button>
			<button class="btn" disabled>Unpublished</button>
		</div>
		<div class="row" style="margin-top: 16px;">
			<span class="iconbtn">✦</span>
			<span class="iconbtn">▶</span>
			<span class="iconbtn">⌘</span>
			<input class="input" placeholder="Search templates…">
			<span class="seg"><span>Monthly</span><span class="is-active">Yearly</span></span>
		</div>
		<p class="note">Pressed feedback is a slight scale-down, never a darker fill. Tabs and
			toggles show their active state with a raised lift and hairline edge — never with
			color. Inputs take a blue-tinted focus ring on dark raised fill.</p>
	</section>

	<!-- 05 MOBILE -->
	<section class="section">
		<p class="section-label">05 — Mobile</p>
		<h2>The Phone breakpoint folds, it does not redesign</h2>
		<p class="lede">At 810px the grids collapse; below that the nav folds into a menu and
			every grid goes single-column. Display type steps down through the tiers while
			keeping its tracking ratio, and the tiles keep their 30px radius.</p>
		<div class="mobile">
			<div>
				<p class="phone-tag">Phone · 390</p>
				<div class="phone">
					<div class="phone-status"><span>9:41</span><span>LTE ▮</span></div>
					<div class="phone-nav"><b>Nudge</b><span>☰</span></div>
					<div class="m-hero">
						<p class="m-kicker">Now in public beta</p>
						<h3 class="m-h1">Ship sites at the speed of thought</h3>
						<p class="m-sub">Design on the canvas, publish to the edge.</p>
						<div class="m-cta"><span class="btn btn-white">Start for free</span></div>
						<span class="m-link">Book a demo →</span>
					</div>
					<div class="m-tile">
						<span class="t-chip">AI</span>
						<h3>Copy that sounds like you</h3>
					</div>
				</div>
			</div>
			<ul class="rules">
				<li><b>< 1199px</b><span>Content grids collapse from three columns to two; the 56px nav keeps its bar.</span></li>
				<li><b>< 810px</b><span>Nav folds into a menu; comparison tables become per-tier accordions; grids go single column.</span></li>
				<li><b>Type</b><span>Display steps 110 → 85 → 44 → 32 keeping the −5% tracking; body drops 15 → 14, never smaller than 12 for captions.</span></li>
				<li><b>Touch</b><span>Pills and rows grow to 44px targets; icon circles keep a 40px core with a larger tap area.</span></li>
				<li><b>Hover → tap</b><span>Hover lifts become pressed scale; translucent pills keep their blur over imagery.</span></li>
				<li><b>Tiles</b><span>Gradient spotlights stack one-up and keep the 30px radius — they never bleed full-width as section backgrounds.</span></li>
			</ul>
		</div>
	</section>

	<!-- 06 OFF-STYLE -->
	<section class="section">
		<p class="section-label">06 — Off-style, for contrast</p>
		<h2>What breaks the artboard</h2>
		<div class="compare">
			<div class="cmp-off">
				<b>Join the future</b>
				<p>Everything you have ever wanted, plus a few things you have not thought of yet.</p>
				<span class="cta">GET STARTED →</span>
				<small>Gradient as a section background, blue-filled squared CTA, heavy uppercase
					headline with no tracking, washed-out body copy. Every rule broken at once.</small>
			</div>
			<div class="cmp-on">
				<span class="mini"></span>
				<span class="txt">
					<b>Ready when you are</b>
					<p>Same message, on-style: white pill, tight tracking, and the gradient confined to one 30px-radius tile.</p>
					<span class="cta">Start for free</span>
				</span>
			</div>
		</div>
		<p class="note">Also out: light mode, mid-tone grays beyond muted, a second chromatic
			accent, and any CTA that is not a pill.</p>
	</section>

</div>
</body>
</html>

resources.content:
# Wise — Vetta Edition

A complete worked example of this system ships alongside this spec as `demo.html`: every rule below applied to one real page, including its mobile layout and a set of deliberately off-style counter-examples. It is the reference for what "on-style" looks like here.

## Atmosphere
Borderless money with its voice turned up. A pale sage canvas hosts soft white
cards and enormous black type; one lime-green button does all the convincing.
It reads like a Scandinavian magazine that happens to move currency, not like
a bank.

## Color roles
All colors come from `theme.css` tokens — never hardcode hex in frames.
- `surface` is the sage canvas (#e8ebe6) — the page mood itself. White
  `surface-raised` cards sit on it, and surface contrast (sage vs white) does
  the job shadows usually do.
- `primary` (#9fe870) lime green is the single CTA color, always paired with
  near-black `primary-foreground` text. It never sits on a green background.
- `accent` (#ffeb69) flag yellow appears only in celebratory details —
  rate-alert stars, "fastest route" confetti, small illustration moments.
- Text is `surface-foreground` (#0e0f0c), support text `muted` (#454745);
  `danger` (#d03238) is reserved for errors and destructive actions.
- Structural outlines on inputs and the converter card use full-strength ink,
  not gray — the confident 1px black border is a signature.

## Typography
System sans pushed to its heaviest:
- Display runs at weight 900, 40–96px, tight leading — the loudest voice in the
  kit. Never render a hero at 700 or lighter.
- Sub-headings and UI labels sit at 600; body at 400, 14–16px.
- Money is the interface: amounts 28–56px, weight 700, `tabular-nums`, with
  currency codes in 600.
- Sentence case everywhere; no uppercase displays.

## Shape & depth
- Cards and buttons share the generous 24px radius (`radius-xl`); inputs take
  12px; small chips 8px. Sharp corners are off-brand.
- Elevation is surface contrast: white card on sage reads as raised without any
  shadow. `shadow-lg` is only for true overlays (modals, toasts).
- Status pills are full-radius: soft green tint for positive, dark maroon fill
  with white text for negative.

## Components
- Buttons: 48px, `radius-xl`, 600 labels — lime fill for primary, sage fill for
  secondary, white with a 1px ink border for tertiary.
- Converter card: white, 1px ink border, 24px radius; from/to amount rows with
  currency chips, a rate row pinned between them.
- Fee rows: quiet hairline dividers, label left in `muted`, value right in
  bold tabular figures.
- Progress steps: numbered circles with a lime track for completed states.
- Badges: full pills; positive uses the soft green tint family, negative the
  dark red fill.

## Layout
Content centers near 1200px; the transfer flow lives in one focused column
(360–480px) beside or above supporting cards. Bands breathe at 48px; card
interiors at 24px. Grids step 3-up → 2-up → 1-up with 16–24px gutters.

## Don'ts
- Never put the lime CTA on a green surface, and never tint page backgrounds
  with it — green is the button, the canvas stays sage or white.
- No second brand accent: yellow is confetti, not a system color; don't add
  purple, teal or blue accents.
- Don't render CTAs or cards with sharp corners, and don't shrink hero type
  below weight 900.
- Don't gray-out the ink borders on inputs — a pale border reads broken here.
- Don't reuse the lime green as a success indicator; semantic status uses its
  own positive/negative palette.

01 — Type & numbers

Money speaks at weight 900

Headlines run at the heaviest weight the system has, tight and unapologetic. Amounts are equally loud but always tabular, so a ticking rate never shuffles the fee rows below. Every money figure pairs with a currency chip, never a bare number.

02 — Color

Lime on neutral, ink for structure

The sage canvas and white cards carry the mood; the lime button is the only saturated action on screen and always sits on sage or white, never on green. Inputs and the converter draw confidence from full-strength ink borders — pale gray borders read as broken here.

  • Amount rowsNumerals drop from 34px to 22px — the floor for money figures — and the currency chip shrinks with them but never disappears.
  • Fee breakdownFour rows compress to the total cost; the full breakdown stays one tap away in the same card, not a new page.
  • StepsThe numbered progress row hides; the receiver chip and guaranteed-rate pill carry the state instead.
  • ButtonsThe lime action pins to the thumb zone at full width and keeps its 48px height — it never shrinks below it.
  • Popular routesThe side card falls below the converter; route rows keep flag pairs and drop the arrival pills on narrow screens.
  • CornersRadius scales down one step (24px → 16px) so cards don't waste width, but nothing ever goes square.
  • Hover statesTouch replaces hover: rows highlight on press, and the swap button gets a generous 44px hit area.

04 — Off-style, for contrast

What kills the friendliness

Sharp box on dark green 6px corners · lime CTA dropped onto a green surface · generic green button competing with the brand action. Every rule here exists to protect the brand's one conversion moment.
Same content, on-style 24px-radius white card on sage, ink-bordered fields, lime on neutral. Surface contrast does the elevation; the lime button stays the only thing shouting.

Also out: weight-700 hero type, gray input borders, pure-white page canvases, and a second accent color — the palette is sage, white, lime, ink, and a pinch of yellow confetti.
